insertion_points.arrival_state: derived.arrival_state: aux.respiratory_distress from the anchors, before the arrival sympathetic target is read
insertion_points.declared_unwired: sympathetic_target's docstring: hypercapnia, pain or agitation, fever, withdrawal (no state); hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia relative to arrival (unchanged)
insertion_points.integration: integration.step: Contribution.distress collected, summed by _distress_after, recorded in MinuteRecord.distress, conserved by _check_conservation
insertion_points.respiratory_drive: derived._composition: excitatory = acid (+ hypoxaemic) (+ gain x distress), then rate_from_drive (saturation), then x central_drive_availability (expressed_respiratory_rate)
insertion_points.sympathetic: derived.sympathetic_target: after the acute-deficit, pressure, debt, hypoxaemia and hypoglycaemia terms, before the baroreflex and max(0, .); beta-blockade downstream in sympathetic_increment

contrasts.note: SYNTHETIC distress and gains on the committed arrival mappings; no value is calibrated or approved

decisions.acid_composition: the existing common composition before saturation; no family exception
decisions.central_depression: no gate on the sympathetic reader is added
decisions.hybrid: arrival: a case / family latent value constrained by independent authored respiratory evidence; evolution: family DistressChange writes; no automatic derivation (never 1 - mechanics efficiency)
decisions.hypoxaemic_drive: mapping and gain UNSET, unchanged (identifiability of chemical vs non-chemical drive)
decisions.mechanics_coupling: a future structural slot only: magnitude UNSET, default off, not implemented as active
decisions.representation: an auxiliary common input, never a canonical V/T/P/R/L/G/W/D/N channel
decisions.respiratory_reader: distress_to_respiratory_drive_gain, UNSET; before the existing saturation; availability unchanged as the expression gate
decisions.scope: respiratory_distress only; systemic_stress / general arousal SYSTEMIC_STRESS_DEFERRED; no asthma remigration
decisions.sympathetic_reader: distress_to_sympathetic_gain, UNSET; a separate gain; deficit, debt, baroreflex, saturation and beta-blockade preserved
decisions.wob: authored work of breathing is evidence for ordering only: no universal numeric mapping, no approved value

parameters.arrival_distress_regions: UNSET; FAMILY_CANDIDATE ordinal regions only in the WOB ordering test
parameters.mechanics_to_distress_coupling: UNSET, off (no structural term is active)

probes.D1: distress 0: the readers declared change no RR and no HR
probes.D10: acid and distress drives compose before the existing saturation
probes.D11: the hypoxaemic and distress drives remain independently addressable
probes.D12: with both readers UNSET every prior candidate reading is exact (the P2S-3 core)
probes.D2: distress > 0 with the respiratory reader: the excitatory drive (and RR) increases; HR unchanged
probes.D3: distress > 0 with the sympathetic reader: the sympathetic target (and HR) increases; RR unchanged
probes.D4: same distress, different gains: the effectors respond independently
probes.D5: distress > 0 with the central drive availability reduced: RR expression suppressed, the distress present
probes.D6: central depression does not suppress the sympathetic reader (no gate added)
probes.D7: distress 0 with severe hypoxaemia: no distress contribution from SpO2
probes.D8: distress 0 with low mechanics efficiency: no distress contribution from the mechanics
probes.D9: a distress change alone moves only its readers' effectors (RR -> W, PaCO2, pH; HR)

criteria: auxiliary distress exists (aux.respiratory_distress, its arrival value, its conservation and refusals)
it is distinct from mechanics, gases and shock (D7, D8, D9, orthogonality, the readers' audit)
a family writer interface exists (DistressChange; additive, persistent, recorded; no family writer yet)
the respiratory reader exists structurally (D2, D10)
the gains are separate and UNSET (D4; the parameter state)
the acid composition is structurally coherent (D10, D11)
the central availability still gates the RR, and not the HR (D5, D6)
the default behaviour is exact (D1, D12, the closed records reproduced, the P2S-3 tree proven)

def _distress_after(state: CoreState, distress: list, profile: CoreProfile, minute: int) -> float:
    """P2T-1: the respiratory distress after the minute: the value it starts with plus the minute's changes. The core
    adds no kinetics and no coupling of its own (the mechanics -> distress slot is UNSET and off). With both readers UNSET
    nothing reads it, so a change is refused; a minute that would take it below 0 is refused, never held."""
    if distress and not respiratory_distress_read(profile):
        raise ProvenanceError(f"minute {minute}: {distress[0].source.key} changed the respiratory distress while both of "
                              "its readers are UNSET (P2T-1): nothing would read it")
    value = state.aux.respiratory_distress + math.fsum(item.amount for item in distress)
    if value < 0.0:
        raise ProvenanceError(f"minute {minute}: the respiratory distress changes take it to {value!r}, below 0 (P2T-1)")
    return value
